production.direction_en: A round archive is carved into the stairwell. Aveline, Mirel, Clem, Pippa and Kera rebuild the erased record from copied names, bell rubbings and Jori's forge marks.
production.music_direction_en: pre: bgm_ledger_motif under the voices reading names | post: bgm_fadyme_theme with choir when the name is written back; this is the emotional peak before the boss

commands.speaker: mirel_quill
commands.text: The ledger was written over, not burned. Someone needed the names to remain beneath the ink.

commands.speaker: sister_aveline
commands.text: I can read the prayer beneath it. The names were offered as witnesses, not sacrifices.

commands.speaker: fadyme_thought
commands.text: I came here to be offered. They are asking me to be witnessed.

commands.speaker: pippa_bell
commands.text: To a promise. The last line says, 'Let the lost hour be remembered by the living.'

commands.speaker: kera_voss
commands.text: There is one space scraped clean. It is the same length as Fadyme's name.

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: Then write it back. A name should not vanish just because someone feared what it meant.

commands.speaker: pippa_bell
commands.text: I will sing it while you write. The page will not dare lose its place.
